result_text:
The region overview now lists open tickets high priority first, then normal, then low, oldest first within each priority. This is the same order the sales-rep list already uses.

The change is one SQL `ORDER BY` in `listOpenSupportTicketsByRegion` in `src/main/java/com/acme/backoffice/DataStorePart10.java`. I copied the `CASE` expression from the sales-rep query and updated that method's Javadoc to match. The region query has no other callers besides the overview, so nothing else changes.

`RegionManagerTest`, `SupportTicketTest` and `RegionReportTest` pass offline. I did not add a test for the new order, so your example (T-3, T-5, T-2, T-4, T-1) is not covered by an automated check. Nothing is committed.
